answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The terrace holds work receipts rather than names, so the sable of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Reaching the cedar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
